integrity: Analytical Gaussian conditioning and small-ball integrability proof; finite-dimensional standalone checks corroborate identities and do not prove moment divergence. Independent scientific validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: One-shot noisy residual least squares with independent full-dimensional isotropic Gaussian evaluations of fixed affinely independent points; no adaptive-trajectory, correlated-oracle, nonlinear convergence, or floating-point guarantees. An equivalent formula in general Gaussian regression or pseudoinverse literature may have prior publication priority.
title: Sharp Gaussian moment threshold for noisy Anderson extrapolation at any memory depth
